payloads.notes: Iowa DOT MM353 under-21 temporary specimen, PDF page 2. The visibly marked SAMPLE card supplies the input values. Its optional DDB field contains the printed date template MMDDCCYY. Official historical origin http://www.iowadot.gov/centralissuance/MM353.pdf. Source-pixel scoring against the public PDF417 symbol alphabet and Reed-Solomon. The target payload was never supplied. 2012 first-generation xref60 and 2014 xref147 independently recovered the same payload; the 2012 interpretation needed 5 corrected codewords with 64 parity words. Apple Vision and ZXing-C++ agree on the inferred optical image. Gray-sampled region; source crop alone did not decode normally.

payloads.privacyReview: The archived state DMV identified the source as a press-quality sample reverse. Encoded family and given names are literal LASTNAME and FIRSTNAME, with ANYTOWN and patterned test numbers. DOB, issue, and expiry are all zero. Companion front explicitly names a SAMPLE persona and does not correspond to these template bytes. No obscured source fields were used.
payloads.notes: Published Nevada DMV central issuance test card reverse. The layout contains zero dates and demographic placeholders. The front illustration shows a separate SAMPLE persona.

reobservations.notes: New Jersey MVC advisory 2011-001 reproduces the existing 687-byte specimen.

excludedObservations.notes: Two readers agreed. The legacy header carries the Mississippi IIN. The back differs from the sample fronts and dummy provenance remains unconfirmed. Hash-only record.
The other specimen on this slide has no confirmed fictitious identity. Only the digest is retained.

anonymizedObservations.publicationTitle: MDOT Sample MD ID Product, Hearing for Senate Bill 87, January 21 2026
anonymizedObservations.sourceAcquisition: Google document preview derived from requested public URL
anonymizedObservations.privacyReview: The issuer labels this MDOT Sample MD ID Product, visibly overprints SAMPLE, and supplies dummy segmented LASTNAME and TESTING values. The issuer obscured the customer number and street/address on its visible front. The reusable fixture masks the customer number, address, ZIP, document discriminator and inventory control number, keeping each byte span and identifier shape. The fixture retains the fabricated specimen names. No original bytes or reusable optical crop are included.
anonymizedObservations.unchangedChecks: All other byte positions and directory entries are identical to the independently decoded publication, with no separator changes. Byte offsets are zero based, end exclusive.
